meta.definition: grid_visible_generation = nameplate_GW × visibility_factor × yield_anchor × shape. User-facing capacity input remains nameplate; factor applied internally only.

solar.interpretation: Rooftop/self-consumption invisible to TSO metering; ~30% of nameplate does not reach wholesale-visible generation.

wind.interpretation: Wind is almost entirely utility-scale and grid-visible. 2024 ratio 0.953 ≈ 1.0 (small capacity-timing/yield gap vs 2000 FLH). 2025 ratio 0.857 reflects a low-wind year (implied 1715 FLH), not metering invisibility — must not be conflated with solar's rooftop gap. Weather/timing handled by windYearType ±5%, not visibility.
